contentScope.rule: Server 504 may publish useful Dark War: Survival reference and guide content through Season 6. Content from a season later than the server's current season must remain accessible but carry a Spoiler Alert tag instead of being blocked.

season6.note: AllClash currently has Season 6 meta/build coverage for Ella and Sebastian but does not provide equivalent Selwyn coverage in the indexed Dark War: Survival set. Keep this as a source gap rather than assuming Selwyn does not exist.

published.note: Guide may use build evidence, but canonical faction remains pending Server 504 verification.

readyForEditorialFilter.note: Cross-check AllClash wording inconsistency before publication.

readyForEditorialFilter.sourceGap: No indexed AllClash build page yet; use other cross-checked community/official evidence when creating this guide.

publicationRules: Do not block a useful article only because it belongs to Season 5 or Season 6.
Anything with season > 4 must display the Spoiler Alert tag in public UI.
Season-specific ranking must identify its source season; never relabel a Season 6 tier list as Season 4 meta.
Official/current in-game evidence and Server 504 evidence still override stale community claims.
A source gap is not evidence that a hero or system does not exist.
conflictRules: Darian: ignore AllClash no-exclusive claim when publishing; official patch-history evidence wins.
Lan: AllClash Fighter classification is community evidence only, not canonical faction proof.
Tristan: resolve source wording inconsistency before turning the recommendation into public advice.
